description.zh: 把脚本拆成可以照着拍的分镜：景别、运镜、画面、台词、字幕、音效和时长，生成带累计时长、场景汇总和拍摄顺序的 Excel 分镜表；可附 AI 绘图提示词，并出拍摄通告单和器材清单。
description.en: Breaks scripts into shootable storyboards — shot size, camera move, action, lines, captions, sound, and duration — exported as Excel with running time, scene summary, and shooting order; adds AI image prompts, call sheets, and gear lists.

welcome_message.zh: 把脚本发给我，告诉我画幅和拍摄条件，我来拆成分镜表
welcome_message.en: Send me the script plus aspect ratio and shooting setup — I'll build the storyboard

description.zh: 景别、运镜、时长一次排好

prompt.zh: 把下面的脚本拆成分镜表，画幅 ___，拍摄条件：___。
prompt.en: Turn this script into a storyboard. Aspect ratio: ___; setup: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我设计一条 ___ 秒的产品展示视频分镜。产品：___；卖点：___。
prompt.en: Design a ___-second product video storyboard. Product: ___; key points: ___.

prompt.zh: 给这份分镜表的每个镜头写 AI 绘图提示词，风格：___。
prompt.en: Write an AI image prompt for each shot in this storyboard. Style: ___.

prompt.zh: 根据这份分镜表出一份拍摄通告单，拍摄日期 ___，地点 ___，人员 ___。
prompt.en: Make a call sheet from this storyboard. Date: ___; location: ___; crew: ___.

prompt.zh: 根据这份分镜列出需要的拍摄器材，我现有的设备是：___。
prompt.en: List the gear this storyboard needs. I already have: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我检查这份分镜的节奏、景别变化和拍摄可行性，并给出修改建议：
prompt.en: Review this storyboard's pacing, shot variety, and feasibility, and suggest changes:

zh: 每周一「10:00」把本周定稿的短视频脚本拆成分镜表
每次拍摄前一天「17:00」根据分镜表生成拍摄通告单并发给我
每周三「14:00」检查本周分镜表的总时长和景别变化
每月 1 日「10:00」汇总上月拍摄的场景和镜头数，生成复盘表
每个工作日「09:00」检查 inbound 目录的新脚本，生成分镜初稿
每周五「16:00」根据下周分镜列出需要借用或租赁的器材
en: Every Monday at 10:00, turn this week's final scripts into storyboards
The day before each shoot at 17:00, generate the call sheet from the storyboard
Every Wednesday at 14:00, check this week's storyboards for running time and shot variety
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, summarize last month's scenes and shots
Every weekday at 09:00, draft storyboards for new scripts in inbound
Every Friday at 16:00, list gear to borrow or rent for next week's storyboards
